focus: mimo-05: Finding triage, agreement with adjudicated gold

label: Every archived deep-review finding carries a transitions array of iteration/from/to/reason records, so the final adjudicated severity and its downgrade rationale are derivable gold with no labeling
The sampled severity spread is P0 6, P1 39, P2 24 across 69 findings in 12 registries, so any P0-savings claim needs a corpus-wide P0 census before the metric can stand
The four reviewer fixtures hold 8 cases total and every expectedVerdict is fail, so the grader-arm gold is single-class and a constant-fail grader scores perfect agreement on it
The P0 triage arm earns its operator surface only at recall at least 0.9 on surviving P0s and at least 30% reread-set reduction; below both the operator-facing change is none
A Jev severity write is dropped: the review contract already makes advisory scores non-gating and the FAIL verdict depends on recorded severity, so authority transfer would corrupt a frozen contract
The sibling build orders treat the H9 reviewer fixtures as usable gold; the 8 single-class case census contradicts that and requires fixture expansion before any grader agreement number is quoted
